fusions.name: Cast Net
fusions.desc: Casts a woven net of fine chain in a cone ahead of you, which deals 4 damage to everything within 3.5 tiles, with a 30% chance to leave it [Slowed] for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Winding Sheet
fusions.desc: Casts a sheet of woven links at an enemy at or below 25% health, dealing 24 damage and leaving it [Pinned] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Field Dressing
fusions.desc: Binds your wounds in woven links: you regain 3 health a second for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Woven Ward
fusions.desc: 15% of the elemental damage you take is dealt back to whoever dealt it.
